_comment: Shared, language-neutral engine fallback for brand_lint (plan §2.2). `acronyms` is the UNIVERSAL core of valid all-caps tokens (product/tech/business acronyms) that every locale inherits: the runtime ACRONYMS set = this core ∪ fiscal.acronyms_fiscal ∪ brand_lint.acronyms_extra. Jurisdiction-specific fiscal acronyms live in each pack's fiscal.acronyms_fiscal, NOT here. `slop_tells` are universal AI-slop giveaways (English) shared as a fallback signal; the ES/EN packs already list these in brand_lint.slop, so they are informational here and not yet unioned by the loader.
